verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API (docs-12), and explicitly describes automating flag toggles from a deploy script via the toggle feature endpoint (docs-58). It also documents pulling experiment results programmatically (docs-71), so the core of headless, CI-driven automation is first-party documented. Risky API changes can be held for human confirmation (docs-72). missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or CI integration (e.g., an official GitHub Action), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
